claim_ceiling: The scalar limit is valid; no theorem connecting it to classical mechanics or determinism is supplied.

identifying zero gate contribution with determinism
ignoring the pole, sign or dimensional requirement

boundaries: r=mu/Lambda must be positive and dimensionless; r must not equal 1.
counterexamples: For r=1 the expression has a pole; for 0<r<1 it is negative, so it is not a nonnegative gate on its stated natural domain.
failure_modes: The limit of an invented scalar kernel does not derive classical mechanics.
mathematical_properties.monotonicity: Strictly decreasing on each connected domain interval
singularities: undefined for r<=0 over the reals

title: 经典确定性函数

allowed_uses: toy comparison of explicitly defined before and after scores
counterexample teaching for aggregation claims
claim_ceiling: A model operation only. Fewer summands do not determine the ordering of Phi or Omega.

definition.domain: Positive scale ratios excluding one, plus an independently defined merge map

forbidden_uses: inferring score improvement from fewer terms
calling symbolic merge physical unification
treating Lambda_AB as defined by its desired conclusion

boundaries: Lambda_AB requires an independent definition; all log ratios require positive dimensionless inputs away from one.
mathematical_properties.continuity: Conditional on a defined Lambda_AB and valid log domains
counterexamples: With mu=10, Lambda_A=Lambda_B=1 and Lambda_AB=9, Phi_before=2/ln(10) but Phi_after=1/ln(10/9)>Phi_before, hence exp(-Phi_after)<exp(-Phi_before).
failure_modes: Term-count reduction alone does not imply an ordering, and model merge does not establish physical unification.

title: 门控面合并统一函数

allowed_uses: two-exponential crossing toy model
dimensionally explicit crossing-time calculation
claim_ceiling: A two-exponential crossing model only, not the second law of thermodynamics and not a cosmological heat-death calculation.

definition.domain: t in a declared real interval, positive mu_0 and Lambda_0
definition.operation: two exponential trajectories and their crossing

forbidden_uses: deriving the second law
predicting cosmic heat death
calling sigma_entropy a measured entropy production rate without data

boundaries: positive initial scales with common units; rates have inverse-time units; sigma+gamma must be nonzero and the crossing must lie in the time domain.
counterexamples: If mu_0<=Lambda_0 with t restricted to nonnegative values, the quoted positive future crossing need not exist; if sigma+gamma=0 the formula divides by zero.
failure_modes: A fitted-form analogy is not a thermodynamic derivation.
mathematical_properties.monotonicity: Lambda increases if sigma>0; mu decreases if gamma>0
singularities: nonpositive initial scales for the logarithm
